name: Microsoft Fairwater AI datacenter, Atlanta (Fayetteville)
summary: Second site in Microsoft's Fairwater family of AI datacenters, in Fayetteville, Georgia, south of Atlanta. It began operating in October 2025 and was unveiled in November 2025 as part of what Microsoft calls an AI superfactory, linked to its Wisconsin Fairwater site by a dedicated AI network. Reports describe a two-storey, liquid-cooled facility of more than 1 million sq ft on 85 acres. The AJC linked it through city records to the QTS campus in Fayetteville, and Epoch AI reports that QTS built it with Microsoft as tenant; neither company has confirmed this. Epoch AI estimates about 636 MW of IT capacity across four buildings by mid-2026.

location.note: Town centroid from Nominatim. A Microsoft spokesperson confirmed Fayetteville but declined to give the exact location; the AJC tied the facility to the QTS campus from permitting records, which is not company-confirmed.

power_sources.description: Microsoft says the Atlanta site relies on highly available utility grid power, which lets it forgo on-site generation, UPS systems and dual-corded distribution for the GPU fleet.
